stem:
Dominique put figures into groups based on certain attributes. Sometimes she put figures into more than one group.

Dominique's Figures

| Group | Attribute                |
|-------|--------------------------|
| 1     | Has all sides congruent  |
| 2     | Has exactly 4 sides       |
| 3     | Is a polygon              |

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: A square could be put into all the groups.

options.label: B
options.text: A triangle could be put into all the groups.

options.label: C
options.text: A rectangle could be put into Groups 1 and 2 only.

options.label: D
options.text: A pentagon could be put into Group 1 only.

difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of geometric figures and their attributes, and reasoning about which groups each figure fits into based on those attributes.
